critical_code_review_comments: sessions_export.py: theme/layout validation ordering correct, defaults to 'light'/'classic' when omitted — clean.
sessions_export.py: Share document includes plan_name snapshot which avoids breakage if plan is later renamed — good.
sessions_export.py: TTL handled via expires_at + 410 Gone semantics (vs 404 for missing) — correct.
master_report.py /share: Reuses MasterReportPayload directly — payload is persisted as-is so PDF re-renders with latest plan data which is desired behavior.
MasterReportModal.handleShare: Correctly guards on Object.values(sections).some(Boolean) before API call — validated.

WhatsApp message includes a replacement char '%EF%BF%BD' (U+FFFD) before plan name — appears to be a corrupted leading emoji in SessionsExportModal share text. MINOR cosmetic issue: the icon at start of the WA text is not rendering as an emoji (likely a non-UTF-8 char in the source). Recommend replacing with plain emoji like '📋' or '🗓'.
